audit_composed_prompt.py.stdout:
usage: audit_composed_prompt.py [-h] --pack PACK --composed COMPOSED [--plain]
                                [--runtime-store RUNTIME_STORE]
                                [--runtime-receipt RUNTIME_RECEIPT]

Audit an agent-composed prompt against a candidate pack.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pack PACK           Candidate pack JSON path or inline JSON.
  --composed COMPOSED   Composed prompt JSON path or inline JSON.
  --plain               Print only pass/fail summary.
  --runtime-store RUNTIME_STORE
  --runtime-receipt RUNTIME_RECEIPT
                        Private receipt saved with this pack; otherwise
                        resolve its exact hash from runtime storage.

generate_images_via_api.py.stdout:
usage: generate_images_via_api.py [-h] --pack PACK
                                  --runtime-receipt RUNTIME_RECEIPT
                                  --composed COMPOSED
                                  --render-request RENDER_REQUEST
                                  [--runtime-store RUNTIME_STORE]
                                  [--concept CONCEPT] [--slug SLUG]
                                  [--model MODEL] [--size SIZE]
                                  [--attempts ATTEMPTS] [--out-base OUT_BASE]
                                  [--ledger LEDGER] [--dry-run]

Generate from an exact pack/receipt/composed/runtime input after fresh audits.
Only the audited text-only runtime string is sent. References and raw prompt
inputs fail before key resolution or a paid invocation. Dry-run has no calls.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pack PACK
  --runtime-receipt RUNTIME_RECEIPT
  --composed COMPOSED
  --render-request RENDER_REQUEST
  --runtime-store RUNTIME_STORE
  --concept CONCEPT
  --slug SLUG
  --model MODEL
  --size SIZE
  --attempts ATTEMPTS
  --out-base OUT_BASE
  --ledger LEDGER
  --dry-run
